title: Design note first: the provider's AS, what it issues, and how a MIMI URI outlives an IdP link
description: docs/design/provider-oauth.md, in the shape of frontend-auth.md: the boundaries table, what the AS issues and to whom, the account model (MIMI URI as the stable local subject, IdP links beside it), what each upstream IdP gives and withholds, the token's audience, and the step plan with sizes. Every child of this epic is written against it, and Mark approves it before any code (AGENTS.md: plans live in the bead's design field, no planning markdown in the repo -- this note is a design document, not a plan).
